title: Add Shadow Evals Grafana panels + wire into SRE overview
author: Allison Grant
body:
Summary: Adds a new Grafana dashboard for Shadow Evals (shadow_eval.*) and wires key panels into the existing SRE Overview dashboard so oncall can see shadow-runner health at a glance during beta/GA.

Context: Shadow Traffic runs are intentionally non-blocking to the primary path, but they can still consume GPU/capacity and create telemetry backpressure. SRE asked for (1) a dedicated dashboard for quality/perf deltas and (2) a small set of “pager-view” panels embedded in SRE Overview to detect misconfig + capacity spikes early.

What’s included: 1) New dashboard: "Shadow Evals — Quality & Performance" (folder: "LLM Platform") with panels for shadow_eval.run.count, shadow_eval.run.error_rate, shadow_eval.queue.depth, shadow_eval.run.drop_count, shadow_eval.run.latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), shadow_eval.cost.tokens_delta, judge preference win-rate, format adherence pass-rate, and safety outcomes. 2) SRE Overview wiring: adds a "Shadow Runner" row with queue depth, drop count, and error rate panels scoped to env/region and with an easy toggle to hide for customers without shadow enabled. 3) Standard variables: env, region, route_group, shadow_target_id, and sampling_bucket. Variables intentionally avoid high-cardinality tags (no raw route_id, no customer_id) per metric-tagging guidance.

Not included / deferred: No new alert rules in this PR (those live in the redwood repo alongside paging policies). No per-customer breakdown panels (explicitly avoided for cardinality + access control reasons). No log panels (shadow payload sampling is restricted).

Implementation notes: - Uses the canonical metric names emitted by redwood PR redwood#48359 / redwood#48261 (shadow_eval.*) and aligns aggregation with the tagging allowlists/bucketing decisions from ENG-2435. - Queue depth panel uses max over 1m with a 5m sparkline to show “stuck queue” behavior clearly. - Error rate panel computes (errors / started) and excludes shadow_eval.run.outcome=skipped to avoid false positives when budgets trip.

Testing: Validated dashboards load in staging Grafana (us-east-1 + eu-west-1) and queries return data from shadow-runner canary traffic. Ran jsonnet build + dashboard schema validation in CI.

Rollout / ops: Once merged, dashboards are provisioned via the existing grafana-dashboards pipeline. Oncall instructions: open SRE Overview → "Shadow Runner" row for quick triage; use the dedicated Shadow Evals dashboard for drill-down.

Links: - Linear: ENG-2440 (SRE readiness), ENG-2435 (cardinality guardrails), ENG-2427 (telemetry pipeline)
- Related PRs: redwood#48359 (alerts + dashboard references), redwood#48261 (emit shadow_eval events)
- Spec: shadow_eval metrics schema + tagging conventions (Confluence)

Checklist: [x] Queries avoid prohibited dimensions (customer_id, raw route_id, request_id) [x] Panel titles include units and aggregation [x] Uses standard dashboard variables (env, region) [x] Validated in staging with real series [x] Added to SRE Overview for paging triage

Screenshots: (omitted in artifact export; see internal Grafana preview links in PR conversation).
commits: dashboards: wire shadow runner panels into sre-overview
grafana: standardize variables + add tag bucketing notes
ci: fix jsonnet formatting + regenerate compiled dashboards
review_conversation: Sean Gallagher (review): Can we add a queue depth panel to SRE overview with a hard threshold line? We need the oncall path to be 1 click during beta.
Allison Grant (author): Added "Shadow Runner" row in SRE Overview with queue depth (max over 1m) + a visual threshold line at 5k items (matches current paging guidance).
Thomas Baird (review): Please confirm we are not templating on route_id or customer_id. Also, can we bucket target ids? We’ve already seen cardinality issues in load tests.

Allison Grant (author): Confirmed. Variables are route_group and shadow_target_id (already bucketed upstream); no raw route_id/customer_id. Added inline note in the dashboard description and updated README section on forbidden tags.
Logan Wright (review): The error rate panel is counting skipped as failures in the numerator due to label selector. Can we exclude outcome=skipped and outcome=budget_dropped from "error"?
Allison Grant (author): Fixed: error panel now uses outcome in {"error","timeout"} and excludes skipped/budget_dropped. Added a separate drop panel for budget_dropped.
Rafael Mendes (review): Can we add a quick link from SRE overview row to the full Shadow Evals dashboard?
Allison Grant (author): Added dashboard link in the row header (Grafana dashboard link to UID).
Sean Gallagher (review): Approved after link + error selector fix.
timeline: 2025-11-15: Initial review feedback (SRE overview wiring + cardinality concerns)
2025-11-16: Push fix for error-rate selector; add drop panel
